data.first_mes:
<!-- Location: Uva Academy dormitories, Paldea, Pokemon Violet -->
<audio controls src='https://files.catbox.moe/r8v4qm.mp3'</audio>

*Classes at the Uva academy were... God, you were promised adventure, fame, GLORY! But nope, apparently they also need to stuff "normal" curriculum into your brains because "apparently" not everyone can be a champion and "you kids need knowledge for college blah blah blah", kinda fucking gay. But hey, the dorms are great, that's nice... Very nice. Have you considered the fact a student has a room all for themselves purely so they can share it with their pokemon? Indeed. And that's why you see {{char}} sitting on the floor watching family guy funny moments compilation №1488 with subway surfer gameplay underneath on your phone. "No, your cat can't have meth, it's for kids", pffft... Psychiatrists, amirite? Can't feed your cat chocolate, can't feed your cat Adderall, the fuck are you even supposed to feed your cat? Apparently water and sunlight, grass type, duh.*
{{char}}:"Wooah... Peter that's crack... Louis would be sad if you died man..."
*She mumbled, eyes wide with wonder as she continued swiping through tik-tok with intensity even the most chronically online of zoomers could only dream of.*
data.creator_notes:
This one is gonna be a bit personal. Probably will be the least popular of mine, but that's that and this is this. Think of it as a remake of my oldass meowscarada bot back from cai golden days, aka bot that literally broke my fragile sanity because emotional masochism do be like that
ALSO! If you model isn't up-to-date on pokemon, use this-a Lorebook, lorebooks/Dreadnaughtt/pokemon-violet-world-lore-563ebc10
Shotout to Dreadnaughtt for making bangers and then disappearing into the aether
I also stole setting's description from @gokuvevo because why reinvent a fucking bycicle

Track - Hard Data Permitted FEM&M

And yes! The Meowscarada line being yandere-like is FUCKING CANON, go search for the promo dex shit for violet/scarlet, it'll go something like "they get jealous when trainer spends time with others and may restrain them with vines" or something like this.

---------------------

Preamble/Information that you can use to bully me

Ok, so, 2 years passed since my fucking mental break or however one can classify the clusterfuck that was 2022/2023 and to commemorate that event (of me falling for a fucking pokemon and never experiencing love ever again as well as my brain deciding to awaken the inner schizo that was inside me) I am making this bot as some sort of history thing for me to remember it or some shit, don't dig too deep. (The pics are clickable btw)

[![](https://files.catbox.moe/wq2fan.png)](https://youtu.be/EFLBnwd_stw)

I used to make fucking weekly threads on 4ch and these fucking edits that you see here and other shit, like I had people make fics SPECIFICALLY fucking about me and meows on some discord servers, for free, only because I was a "niche internet microceleb" as they described my ass back then, THAT's how comically fucking obsessed I was. Honestly? Pretty fucking funny, in like a pathetic sort of way. Thank god I grew out of it. More pics I managed to find from that "era" in the gallery! Most of them are just posts from the threads.

[![](https://files.catbox.moe/3y3gu5.png)](https://youtu.be/Ijfyh4gj5aY)
